    AI Overview
    "GM" most commonly refers to General Motors Company, a major American multinational automotive manufacturer headquartered in Detroit, Michigan, known for brands like Chevrolet, Buick, GMC, and Cadillac. It is a publicly traded company (NYSE: GM) focusing on vehicle design, manufacturing, and electric vehicle technology. 
    General Motors (Automotive/Business) 
    • Brands: Chevrolet, Buick, GMC, Cadillac.
    • Leadership: Mary Barra (Chair & CEO).
    • Key Focus: Known for producing trucks, crossovers, cars, and, increasingly, electric vehicles (EVs) with charging technology.
    • Market Position: Largest automaker in the U.S. for multiple years.
    • History: Founded in 1908 by William C. Durant, the company restructured in 2009.
    • Operations: Operates numerous facilities globally, including parts brands GM Genuine Parts and ACDelco. 
    Other Contexts 
    • General Manager (GM): A high-level business or sports executive responsible for operations (e.g., in the NFL).
    • Good Morning (gm): Commonly used on social media/chat.
    • Gmail: Google's email service, accessible through accounts.google.com. 
    For official information, news, or to explore vehicles, visit the official General Motors website.

    AI Overview
    To sign in to Gmail, go to mail.google.com and password, then click "Next" to access your inbox. If you are already signed in, click your profile picture and select "Add another account." 
    Steps to Sign In (Desktop & Mobile)
    • Via Browser: Go to gmail.com, enter your username, and click "Next." Input your password and click "Next". 
    • Via App: Open the Gmail app, tap "Sign in," and enter your credentials. 
    • Troubleshooting: If you cannot sign in, use the "Forgot password?" option, ensure cookies are enabled, or verify your identity via 2-Step Verification. 
    Important Tips
    • If you're on a public computer, use "Guest mode" to sign in privately. 
    • If you have multiple accounts, you can switch between them by tapping your profile picture at the top right.

      Account Creation. How to create a Gmail account?
      About this result
      Feedback
      An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
      AI Overview
      To create a Gmail account, go to the Google Account sign-in page, click "Create account," and choose "For my personal use". Follow the prompts to enter your name, birthday, gender, and create a unique username and password. You may be asked to verify your phone number via SMS. 
      This video shows you how to create a new Gmail account in a few simple steps:
      32s
      Alex Berman
      YouTube · Feb 27, 2025
      Step-by-Step Instructions:
      1. Go to the Sign-In Page: Visit accounts.google.com. 
      2. Create Account: Click Create account and select "For my personal use" (or for work/child). 
      3. Enter Details: Enter your first and last name, birthdate, and gender. 
      4. Choose Username: Choose a unique username (your new username@gmail.com address). 
      5. Create Password: Create a strong, unique password and confirm it. 
      6. Verify Phone Number: Google may require you to enter your phone number to verify you are not a robot. Enter the verification code sent to your phone. 
      7. Recovery Information (Optional but Recommended): Add a recovery email or phone number to help secure your account. 
      8. Agree to Terms: Review the Privacy and Terms, then click I Agree. 
      Important Tips:
      • If a username is already taken, you will need to choose a different one. 
      • If you are already signed in, click your profile picture in the top right and select Add another account to create a new one. 
      • Your new username and password will work for all Google services, including YouTube and Google Drive.

        Search Functionality. How to use Gmail's search functionality?
        About this result
        Feedback
        An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
        AI Overview
        Use Gmail's search bar at the top to find emails by keywords, sender, or subject, and click the filter icon to the right to open advanced options. Use "search chips" (e.g., From, Has Attachment, Date) to narrow results instantly. Combine commands (e.g., from:boss has:attachment) to quickly locate specific, older, or large emails. 
        This video provides a basic tutorial on how to use the search function in Gmail:
        1m
        itGenius 🤓 Biz Tech Experts
        YouTube · Oct 17, 2022
        Essential Search Techniques
        • Basic Search: Type keywords, names, or email addresses into the top search bar. Gmail scans subject lines, sender info, and body content. 
        • Search Chips (Filters): After typing a query, use the buttons below the search box (e.g., "From", "Has Attachment", "Date") to refine results. 
        • Advanced Search Panel: Click the Show search options icon (downward arrow) on the right side of the search bar to filter by specific fields like size, specific words, or date ranges. 
        • Search Across All Mail: If a message is missing, search within spam or trash by choosing "All Mail" in the dropdown, or use the in:anywhere operator. 
        Top Search Operators (Commands)
        Use these commands directly in the search bar for faster results:
        • from:name: Find emails from a specific person.
        • to:name: Find emails you sent to a specific person. 
        • subject:word: Search for words in the subject line.
        • has:attachment: Only show emails with files.
        • filename:pdf: Find specific file types (e.g., .pdf, .docx). 
        • older_than:1y: Find emails older than one year (can use 'd', 'm', 'y').
        • label:work: Search within a specific label. 
        • -"word": Exclude emails containing a certain word. 
        This video explains how to use search operators to fine-tune your Gmail search results:
        37s
        Freedom Scientific Training
        YouTube · Jun 14, 2024
        Tips for Better Results
        • Combine Operators: Use multiple filters together, such as from:john has:attachment after:2025/01/01 to find recent files from John. 
        • Exact Matches: Use quotation marks for specific phrases (e.g., "project report"). 
        • Create Filters: Turn a search into a permanent filter by selecting Create filter in the advanced search panel.

          Labels and Filters. How to use Gmail's labels and filters?
          About this result
          Feedback
          An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
          AI Overview
          Gmail labels (tags) and filters (automatic rules) help manage your inbox by organizing and sorting emails instantly. Create labels via the left sidebar, and set filters by clicking the "down arrow" in the search bar, entering criteria (like "From"), and selecting "Create filter" to automate actions such as applying labels, starring, or archiving. 
          Using Gmail Labels
          Labels allow you to categorize messages, acting similarly to folders but with more flexibility, as a single message can have multiple labels. 
          • Create a Label: Click the + sign next to "Labels" in the left-hand menu, or go to Settings (gear icon) > See all settings > Labels > Create new label. 
          • Add Color: Click the three dots menu next to a label to add colors for visual organization. 
          • Apply Labels: Drag and drop emails onto a label, or select the label icon from the toolbar while reading an email.
          This video shows you how to create and use labels in Gmail:
          58s
          Tasia Custode
          YouTube · Oct 27, 2022
          Using Gmail Filters
          Filters automatically perform actions on incoming emails based on criteria you define. 
          1. Open Filter Menu: Click the down arrow (Show search options) inside the Gmail search bar. 
          2. Set Criteria: Enter criteria (e.g., from specific sender, keywords in subject) and click Create filter. 
          3. Choose Action: Choose what the filter does, such as:
            • Skip the Inbox (Archive it) 
            • Apply the label: Assign to a specific label. 
            • Star it 
            • Forward it 
          4. Apply to Existing Emails: Check "Also apply filter to matching conversations" to organize current inbox items. 
          5. Finalize: Click Create filter.
          This video demonstrates how to set up and use filters in Gmail:
          56s
          Simpletivity
          YouTube · Oct 22, 2020
          Pro-Tips
          • Filter Existing Messages: Use the search bar to find emails, click the slider icon, and select "Create filter" to act on them immediately.
          • Filter from Specific Emails: Open an email, click the three-dot menu (More), and choose Filter messages like these. 
          • Use Operators: Use OR to filter multiple senders (e.g., from:user1 OR from:user2) and * as a wildcard for domains. 
          • Edit/Delete Filters: Go to Settings > Filters and Blocked Addresses to modify or remove existing rules.

            About this result

            AI Overview
            To change your Gmail password, sign into your Google account on a browser or app, go to Manage your Google Account > Security > Password, and enter a new password after verifying your identity. This changes the password for all Google services (YouTube, Drive, etc.). 
            Steps to Change Gmail Password (Desktop & Mobile)
            1. Sign in: to your Gmail or Google account.
            2. Click your profile picture/icon in the top right corner.
            3. Select Manage your Google Account.
            4. Navigate to the Security tab (on the left for desktop, or top menu for mobile).
            5. Under "How you sign in to Google," click Password.
            6. You may need to sign in again.
            7. Enter your new password, confirm it, and select Change Password. 
            This video demonstrates how to change your Gmail password on both desktop and mobile devices:
            1m
            Tech Life Unity
            YouTube · Jun 15, 2023
            Important Notes
            • Requirements: Your new password must be at least eight characters long. 
            • Devices: After changing, you may need to sign in again on other devices. 
            • Forgot Password: If you cannot sign in, choose "Forgot password" during the login process to reset it. 
            • Security Tip: Avoid reusing old passwords to maintain high security.
